Senior Fullstack Python Developer at BairesDev
We are looking for a Fullstack Python Developer to join our elite development team. This role emphasizes strong Python backend expertise while requiring frontend development skills with modern web technologies. You'll be responsible for developing end-to-end solutions, from robust backend services to responsive user interfaces.
 What You'll Do
 Develop Python backend applications and APIs.
 Build data analysis solutions using Pandas.
 Create responsive frontend interfaces.
 Implement database interactions and AWS integrations.
 Collaborate with teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
 What We're Looking For
 5+ years of experience with Python.
 Strong experience with Pandas.
 Proficiency in frontend development (HTML/CSS/JavaScript).
 Experience with AWS Cloud Services.
 Upper Intermediate English level.
 Nice To Have
 Experience with Streamlit.
 Knowledge of AWS Bedrock.
 Containerization experience (Docker, Kubernetes).
 Expertise in database design and optimization.
